name: Neblina Tapaculo
rangeDescription: Central andes of peru (southern amazonas to huánuco)
description: Small tapaculo found only at very high elevations in the eastern Andes of Peru. Male is gray with black and brown barring on lower underparts and rump.

name: Spiny-cheeked Honeyeater
rangeDescription: Interior of australia, to coasts in south and west
description: Medium to large honeyeater of inland Australia. Its heavily streaked plumage, large pale cinnamon throat patch and upper-chest are notable.

name: Meyer's Goshawk
rangeDescription: Moluccas to new guinea, new britain (southeastern bismarck archipelago), and solomon islands
description: A rare, powerful raptor of hill and montane forest edge and clearings. Black upperparts and white underparts with fine black barring on the flanks.

name: Everett's Scops-Owl
rangeDescription: Philippines (bohol, samar, biliran, leyte, mindanao, and basilan)
description: A fairly small owl of lowland and foothill forest. Dark brown on the back with barred wing feathers, grayish underparts, a darker chest with black markings, a pale gray facial disk bordered with a black line, and pale ear tufts forming a V.

name: Pygmy Swiftlet
rangeDescription: Philippines (except sulu archipelago)
description: A tiny, common swiftlet found over lowland forest. Gray below with a paler belly, a darker throat, and dark patches on the underside of the base of the forewing.

name: Koepcke's Hermit
rangeDescription: Foothills of east slope of andes of peru
description: Large, orangish hermit from the Andean foothills. Light orange with a grayish-green back and a black mask typical of hermits.

name: Yellow-eyed Bristlebill
rangeDescription: Democratic republic of the congo (except along lower congo river) to southern central african republic, southwestern south sudan, and uganda
description: An unusual and colorful rainforest bulbul. The upperparts are dark olive-green and the underparts yellow.

name: Nariño Tapaculo
rangeDescription: Pacific slope of southwestern colombia (risaralda) to ecuador (cotopaxi)
description: A standard Scytalopus tapaculo: plain dark gray with browner flanks and rump. Acts like a mouse, scurrying around on or near the ground within montane forest.

name: Ochre-breasted Pipit
rangeDescription: Locally in southeastern brazil, southeastern paraguay, and northeastern argentina
description: Fairly distinctive for a pipit: blackish-brown above, including the wings, with bright golden feather edgings giving it a boldly streaked appearance. The chest and flanks are buff and lightly streaked.

name: Great Thick-knee
rangeDescription: Southeastern iran to indian subcontinent, indochina, and hainan
description: An odd-looking wader with a dark mask, staring pale eyes, and a large heavy bill. Flashing black-and-white wingtips, revealed in flight, recall those of lapwings.

name: Flores Sea Sunbird
rangeDescription: Tanahjampea, kalao, bonerate, kalaotoa, and madu islands
description: Tiny and active sunbird of forest edges and open woodlands, endemic to a string of Flores Sea islands from Tanahjampea east to Kalaotoa and Madu. Male is dark gray-brown above, with an extensive iridescent blue-black throat; if seen well, note a dark coppery belt dividing the iridescent throat from the black belly.

name: Sjöstedt's Greenbul
rangeDescription: Locally in cameroon, equatorial guinea, western gabon, and northeastern democratic republic of the congo
description: A unusual dark greenbul often found near water in the forest interior. Decorated in various shades of dark and olive green, with a gray throat that contrasts with the breast, a buffy belly, and bright white sides of the tail.

name: Saffron-headed Parrot
rangeDescription: Far eastern panama to northern colombia and northwestern venezuela
description: Unmistakable medium-sized parrot found from eastern Panama into Colombia and Venezuela. Green body with a bright yellow head and white eyering.

name: Short-billed Miner
rangeDescription: Breeds southern chile and southern argentina; winters northward to mendoza
description: Breeds in Tierra del Fuego and adjacent southern Patagonia; migrates north in winter. Favors open shrub steppe, grassy areas, and gravel roadsides.

name: Azores Chaffinch
rangeDescription: Azores
description: Dapper little finch endemic to the Azores, where it inhabits a range of habitats, from forests to farmlands. Handsome, brightly colored male has a blue-grayish cowl, pale orangish face and breast, and a black-and-white wing pattern (colors muted in winter).

name: Blackthroat
rangeDescription: West-central china (southeastern gansu, southwestern shaanxi, northern sichuan, and northern yunnan)
description: A somberly-colored robin which breeds in dense bamboo thickets. Male is slate-gray above (only a hint of blue may be detected in good lighting) with a white belly and black bib.

name: Stubble Quail
rangeDescription: Grassland of australia (except north) including tasmania
description: Large, strongly marked quail with pale breast/belly with heavy dark streaks. Note bold pale eyebrow.

name: Long-tailed Paradigalla
rangeDescription: Western new guinea (arfak and fakfak mountains)
description: A large, fairly long-tailed bird of montane forest on the Bird’s Head of New Guinea. All black plumage with iridescence on the head, fairly long bill, distinctive, yellow wattle between the eye and the bill.

name: Asian Stubtail
rangeDescription: Breeds northeastern asia; winters to southeastern asia and taiwan
description: A well-named tiny songbird, “a head with wings,” with rather long bill, long legs, and very short tail. Long buffy supercilium is conspicuous even in the gloomy leaf litter and dense shrubbery where this minute bird lurks.

name: Perija Antpitta
rangeDescription: Sierra de perijá (colombia/venezuela border)
description: Medium-sized antpitta restricted to the Perijá Mountains, which lie north of the main chain of the Andes and straddle the border between Colombia and Venezuela. Plumage is mostly light brown, with a buffy tinge to its head and throat, pale belly, and white eyering.
